author: TEDx Talks
description:
Have you ever considered virality to be a form of art? Internet artist Vita Kari explores how the web has transformed the artistic landscape, shifting from a decentralized playground of self-expression into an attention-driven marketplace. In this captivating and visually surprising talk, they reveal how we can reclaim social media as a creative studio rather than a storefront. Discover the liberating power of "digital refusal" and learn why embracing the "cringe" might just be the ultimate key to unlocking your creativity in the digital age. Vita Kari (they/them) is a visual artist from Los Angeles investigating virality through textiles, performance, and video.  

Kari focuses on the relationship between internet culture, diaspora, and public space, through their lens of being a deaf/Hard of Hearing (HOH) artist. Their figurative tapestries (inspired by their grandmother’s rugs), often feature unweaving that obscures the image, like missing dialogue without captions while deaf/HOH.
title: Does social media kill creativity? | Vita Kari | TEDxUofW

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Sharing food can reduce loneliness, strengthen communities and create connection across cultures. 

This talk explores the power of food, communal eating and breaking bread to bring people together in an increasingly disconnected world. Daniel is a former actuary turned full time cooking content creator whose work centres on transforming food into meaning. Through thoughtful storytelling and visually driven cooking, he uses food as a metaphor to explore life, culture, and human experience in a way that is both relatable and accessible.

A passionate advocate for global cuisine, Daniel celebrates flavours from around the world, highlighting the beauty of cultural diversity while thoughtfully breaking down the key flavour profiles that define each cuisine and the stories behind them. His content bridges education and emotion, inviting audiences to see food not just as sustenance, but as a language that connects people across backgrounds.

Beyond food, Daniel brings the same discipline a
title: The power of sharing food | Daniel Bui | TEDxNorthern Quarter

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Personal growth often focuses on becoming someone new, but the real challenge may be removing what's already getting in the way. 

This talk explores identity, recovery and destructive patterns, showing how removing our blocks can reveal more of who we already are. Scott Thomas is a British television personality, entrepreneur and keynote speaker best known for his breakthrough appearance on Love Island in 2016, where he reached the final and became a familiar face on UK screens.

Since then, Scott has built a successful career beyond reality TV: he’s the founder and CEO of The Social PR, a creative agency and talent management business, and has launched podcast projects like Learning As I Go and Mancs on the Mic with his brothers. Drawing on his experience in media, business and personal development.

Scott speaks with energy and insight about entrepreneurship, resilience and navigating life in the public eye. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but in
title: What's really blocking you? | Scott Thomas | TEDxNorthern Quarter

author: TEDx Talks
description:
We often mistake emotional suppression for strength. 

Through experiences of hardship, cancer and rebuilding, this talk reframes resilience as vulnerability, connection and the courage to ask for help when we need it most. Asia Sharif is a multi-award-winning software engineer, mentor, and inspirational speaker whose extraordinary journey spans continents and defies expectations. 

By teaching herself to code during lockdown, eventually becoming a prominent figure in fintech and a multi-award-winning engineer. Along the way, she has mentored dozens of aspiring technologists and advocated for greater diversity in tech, especially for women of colour and those from underrepresented backgrounds.

Asia’s life took another dramatic turn when she was diagnosed with stage 4 cancer in the midst of her rising career. Her resilience in overcoming multiple relapses, a stem cell transplant, and the loss of her physical identity has made her a powerful voice on what true resilience really means;
title: The myth of strength | Asia Sharif | TEDxNorthern Quarter

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Why does Gen Z clash with managers in the workplace? 

This talk challenges stereotypes about young professionals and argues that many Gen Z workplace problems are really leadership problems, offering a different way to lead multigenerational teams. Alex Atherton is the ex-secondary school headteacher who heard the word ‘snowflake’ once too often about his former students. He is on a mission to change how we understand Gen Z, the most misunderstood generation. Alex recently published his book The Snowflake Myth.

His unique insider perspective on generational workplace culture comes from daily frontline experience leading multigenerational teams and understanding what genuinely drives today’s young professionals. 

He is a Yorkshireman with a strong connection to Manchester having lived there throughout the nineties.

The northern quarter is where he spent his formative years as a young professional, and he cannot wait to return for TEDx. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the
title: Fix how you lead Gen Z in the multigenerational workplace | Alex Atherton | TEDxNorthern Quarter

author: TEDx Talks
description: Nascida no Corvo, a menor ilha dos Açores com cerca de quatrocentos habitantes, Catarina Andrade poderia ter partido à procura de oportunidades noutros lugares. Em vez disso, decidiu criá-las na sua terra. Nesta talk, partilha a história da SAZOREA e o que aprendeu sobre empreendedorismo, identidade e o poder de acreditar no lugar de onde se vem — porque não existe lugar pequeno demais para um grande sonho. Catarina Nascimento Andrade nasceu na ilha do Corvo — a menor ilha dos Açores, com menos de quatrocentos habitantes. Em vez de partir em busca de oportunidades noutros lugares, decidiu criar oportunidades a partir do lugar onde cresceu. Fundou a SAZOREA, um projeto que transforma os produtos e a identidade da região em negócio com alma. A sua história é sobre o que acontece quando alguém acredita genuinamente no lugar de onde vem e tem a coragem de apostar nisso quando ninguém ainda acreditava. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently or
title: Não Existe Lugar Pequeno Demais para um Grande Sonho. | Catarina Andrade | TEDxHorta

author: TEDx Talks
description: Francisco Ávila leva-nos nesta talk a uma viagem pelas camadas mais profundas da existência humana, explorando a consciência, a identidade e os veículos invisíveis que moldam a forma como percebemos e vivemos a realidade. Uma talk que desafia o que pensamos saber sobre nós próprios e nos convida a questionar o que realmente nos ancora. Francisco Ávila é investigador e coach. O seu trabalho explora as questões mais fundamentais da existência humana — quem somos, o que nos move, o que nos ancora e o que nos impede de avançar. Parte da ciência e chega à vida prática, acompanhando pessoas em processos de autoconhecimento e transformação. A sua talk é um convite a olhar para dentro com honestidade e curiosidade, e a perceber que as respostas que procuramos muitas vezes já estão connosco. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Além da matéria: Os veículos da nossa existência. | Francisco Ávila | TEDxHorta

author: TEDx Talks
description: Franco Pinilla e Rafael Ávila Melo, fundadores do BIOMA no Pico, exploram nesta talk a gastronomia como linguagem, uma forma de contar a história de um território, das suas pessoas e da sua identidade. Uma conversa sobre o que se perde quando nos desligamos da origem do que comemos e o que se ganha quando voltamos a essa ligação. Franco Pinilla e Rafael Ávila Melo são os fundadores do BIOMA, no Pico. Criaram um restaurante que não é apenas um espaço de refeições — é uma forma de pensar o território, os seus produtos e a identidade de uma ilha através da gastronomia. O BIOMA nasceu da convicção de que cozinhar é um ato profundamente ligado ao lugar, à memória e às pessoas que habitam esse lugar. A sua talk é uma conversa a dois sobre o que significa cozinhar com raízes, sobre a responsabilidade de quem trabalha com o que a terra e o mar têm para dar, e sobre o que se perde quando essa ligação se quebra. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independent
title: E Se a Gastronomia Não Fosse Apenas Comida? | Franco Pinilla & Rafael Ávila Melo | TEDxHorta

description:
What happens when traditional Kurdish heritage meets modern vision? 
 Lara Dizeyee, The visionary Kurdish fashion designer. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx

author: TEDx Talks
description: Rita Silva, especialista em saúde funcional e integrativa, explora nesta talk a ligação profunda entre o corpo e as crenças que carregamos e como essas crenças moldam a nossa biologia, as nossas emoções e a nossa qualidade de vida. Uma abordagem que vai além dos sintomas e nos convida a olhar para a saúde de forma mais completa, consciente e humana. Rita Silva é especialista em saúde integrativa e funcional. O seu trabalho parte de uma convicção simples mas poderosa: a saúde não é apenas a ausência de doença. É um equilíbrio entre o corpo, a mente e o estilo de vida — e esse equilíbrio pode ser trabalhado, aprendido e mantido. Ao longo da sua carreira, tem acompanhado pessoas que querem perceber melhor o que se passa dentro delas e encontrar formas mais conscientes e sustentadas de viver. A sua abordagem combina o rigor da medicina com uma visão mais ampla do ser humano. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local communit
title: Saúde Funcional e Integrativa: a ligação entre corpo e crenças | Rita Silva | TEDxHorta

author: TEDx Talks
description: Ricardo Andorinho passou anos a competir ao mais alto nível como internacional português de andebol. Nesta talk, explora o que acontece quando o desporto de alta competição termina e como as lições aprendidas em campo se transformam em ferramentas para a vida, para as equipas e para as organizações. Uma conversa sobre liderança, resiliência e o que o desporto nos ensina sobre gerir o caos interior. Ricardo Andorinho construiu uma carreira de alto rendimento como internacional português de andebol. Durante anos representou Portugal ao mais alto nível, acumulando uma experiência que poucos atletas conseguem traduzir para fora do campo. Depois de encerrar a carreira desportiva, fez uma transição que poucos conseguem: levou a disciplina, a visão e a exigência do desporto para o mundo da gestão e do desenvolvimento organizacional. Hoje trabalha com equipas e líderes, ajudando-os a aplicar o que o desporto ensina sobre resiliência, foco e construção coletiva. O seu percurso é a prova de que
title: O Caos Interior Organiza-se em Equipa | Ricardo Andorinho | TEDxHorta

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Before you arrived here today, hundreds of people you will never meet helped make your morning possible.

Electricity, water, transport, logistics, infrastructure, information, and countless handovers operate quietly behind the visible world around us. In this talk, Will Aldridge explores the invisible systems of coordination that allow modern civilization to function.

Drawing on experience in military operations, infrastructure logistics, and technology transformation, including work supporting major nuclear construction programs, Will explains why complex systems can fail even when every individual is making a reasonable decision.

At the heart of his argument is the idea of operational visibility: giving the right people a shared, trusted picture of where something is, what state it is in and what needs to happen next.

Technology, automation and AI can help — but technology alone cannot create coordination or trust.

The future of complex systems may depend less on having more da
title: The Invisible Systems That Run the World | Will Aldridge | TEDxOsney

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In this thought-provoking talk, Gurinder Bhatti explores how the experiences we go through can shape our relationship with risk, possibility and success. A single difficult incident can become a mental filter, making us choose safety over possibility and convincing us that we are not made for something bigger.

Drawing from his own entrepreneurial journey, Gurinder shares why he believes we are all born with the ability to negotiate, solve problems and make things happen — but life can condition us to forget those instincts.

His message is simple: don’t let one incident become the centre point of your life. Drop the filters, trust yourself, invest in people and keep moving forward. Gurinder Bhatti is a first-generation entrepreneur who has spent nearly two decades building businesses across education, hospitality, technology, manufacturing, and real estate. He began his journey in 2003 by founding ESS Global, transforming it into one of North India's leading education services brands
title: The One Thing Holding You Back From Becoming an Entrepreneur | Gurinder Bhatti | TEDxSukhna Lake

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What is needed to educate the child for a different tomorrow?

Isha Jauhar challenges the way that education is perceived, in her TEDx JIM Indore speech, in an effort to think out of the box and examine learning beyond the classroom, beyond the exam and beyond the definition of success.

It encourages reflection on the need to allow children to explore their potential, expand their scope and envision what is possible.

Insightful discussion of education, opportunity and how learning prepares the youth to enter into the world and become part of it.

What children have been learning, I suppose, is the question to ask, but what they want to become is the question I should ask. Isha Jauhar is a social impact professional and Programme Lead at Pathshala, where she works on initiatives focused on education, youth development, and community-led change. She is associated with TYCIA Foundation and has contributed to programmes that support grassroots leadership, entrepreneurship, and opportuni
title: "Before We Teach, Let Them Dream" | Isha Jauhar | TEDxJIM Indore

author: TEDx Talks
description:
We have more information about our oceans than ever before. But what happens when that knowledge doesn't reach the people who need it in time?

Oceanographer and climate resilience strategist Jagadish Kumar Vallarampara draws on more than two decades of experience working with ocean data, offshore environments, and coastal systems to explore a critical distinction: knowledge only becomes powerful when it reaches people and becomes action.

From a missed helicopter flight and the lessons of offshore survival to the devastating consequences of warnings that fail to reach vulnerable coastal communities, Jagadish asks us to rethink what ocean intelligence is for.

His journey leads to TERAOM — a vision for coastal infrastructure that brings together energy, habitat, and real-time intelligence, transforming defensive structures into systems designed for resilience. "Jagadish Vallarampara is a climate resilience strategist and offshore systems specialist exploring how future coastal infrast
title: The Ocean Knows: Turning Data Into Coastal Resilience | Jagadish Kumar Vallarampara | TEDxOsney

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What does it look like when a classroom is in a beehive? 
Eleena George, a teacher, an educator, speaks about her experiences of working with inmates in prison to Project Unlearn in her TEDxJIMIndore speech. Her speech asks one to put aside their preconceived notions about an individual and to ask himself whether making an error to shape the rest of his existence is an honest means of determining his character? A class in the prison was the source for powerful insights into the transforming possibilities of education, empathy and opportunity to begin again, as Eleena reflects. She calls attention to the importance of offering second chances, not as a do-over but as a chance to learn and grow and rebuild. Her point of view suggests new definitions and reimagining of classroom; of punishment; of post-punishment; of human potential; and sometimes, of the most important lessons being learned in the most unconventional of classrooms. Eleena George is a social entrepreneur and advocate for
title: "Project Unlearn : Rethinking Education" | Eleena George | TEDxJIM Indore

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Vivimos rodeados de voces que nos dicen qué hacer, qué pensar, cómo vivir y hasta cómo sentir. En esta charla, Raúl Rosillo parte de su experiencia como ser sensible y creativo para cuestionar una sociedad que nos enseña a desconectarnos de nosotros mismos para encajar. Frente a la velocidad, el ego y la necesidad de pertenecer, reivindica la sensibilidad como una forma de inteligencia, percepción y resistencia. En un mundo de inteligencia artificial, propone volver a lo que ninguna máquina puede replicar: la experiencia de sentir. Porque quizá no estamos aquí para encajar, sino para recordar a otros cómo sentir.

(TEDxCasco Antiguo, Organizador : Vineet Chhatria) Raúl Rosillo es director creativo y de imagen, cineasta y fotógrafo que concibe cada proyecto como un todo, donde estrategia, narrativa y estética se integran de forma orgánica. Ha desarrollado la imagen de marcas internacionales hoy referentes, liderado campañas y trabajado en cine, documentales y fotografía editorial para
title: Te enseñaron a no sentir | Raúl Rosillo | TEDxCasco Antiguo

author: TEDx Talks
description:
At 16, he entered the world of investing with curiosity, confidence and a little money borrowed from his father. He lost it. Then he lost more. But those early failures taught him lessons that no YouTube video or textbook could.

Over time, the question changed—from “How much can I make?” to “How much can I afford to lose?” He learned that markets reward discipline over excitement, that asking the right questions matters more than having all the answers, and that real learning comes from mistakes.     

Today, as he works with investments and capital allocation, he looks beyond the markets to a much bigger question: how do we prepare for a future we cannot predict? Divam Juneja is the Founder of Juneja Ventures LLP and a young investor representing a new generation of disciplined wealth creators in India. He began his investing journey at the age of 15, developing an early interest in macroeconomics and financial markets that shaped his approach to long-term investing. Today, he leads
title: What Losing Money Taught Me About Winning | Divam Juneja | TEDxSukhna Lake
